package day1;

public class Daily_Assignment_28_09_26 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		
		//to print the ASCII values of A,a,0,@
		
		char alpha1='A';
		int num1=alpha1;
		System.out.println("ASCII value of A="+num1);
		
		char alpha2='a';
		int num2=alpha2;
		System.out.println("ASCII value of a="+num2);
		
		char alpha3='0';
		int num3=alpha3;
		System.out.println("ASCII value of 0="+num3);
		
		char alpha4='@';
		int num4=alpha4;
		System.out.println("ASCII value of @="+num4);
		
		
		//to print the triangle pattern using only system.out.println()statements
		
		System.out.println("*");
		System.out.println("**");
		System.out.println("***");
		System.out.println("****");
		System.out.println("*****");
		
		//to print the explicity typecast value and stored value
		
		double marks4=10.75;
		System.out.println(marks4);
		int num5=(int)marks4;
		System.out.println(num5);
	}

}
